review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the 594 archived trigger files at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (119 calendar days, 100 active, index of dispersion of the daily counts 39.77 with the sample variance) and on a deterministic analysis whose 35 self-checks pass. The Poisson distribution it uses is a benchmark, not a fitted model, and the three control logs and the transfer-task log are synthetic. The bursts sit in two episodes, so the draft concludes that the mean is not a usable planning description and that this sample cannot say how often bursts occur; its expectation that the busiest days were mostly push events was contradicted by the data. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
